scripts.cf:deploy: NITRO_PRESET=cloudflare_module nuxt build && node scripts/sync-wrangler-ids.mjs && node ../../scripts/deploy-order.mjs --deploy "npx wrangler --cwd .output deploy" --resync "node scripts/sync-wrangler-ids.mjs" --migrate "npx wrangler d1 migrations apply kdm-db --remote"
scripts.cf:staging: NUXT_PUBLIC_CROUTON_REVIEW=true NITRO_PRESET=cloudflare_module nuxt build && node scripts/sync-wrangler-ids.mjs && node scripts/inject-wrangler-env.mjs && node ../../scripts/deploy-order.mjs --env staging --deploy "npx wrangler deploy --config .output/server/wrangler.json --env staging" --resync "node scripts/sync-wrangler-ids.mjs && node scripts/inject-wrangler-env.mjs" --migrate "npx wrangler d1 migrations apply kdm-staging-db --env staging --remote"
scripts.db:migrate: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply kdm-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:prod: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply kdm-db --remote
scripts.db:migrate:staging: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply kdm-staging-db --env staging --remote
